title: Complete modules 1 materialize original classes and resources
description: Build the exact original Maven revisions and reactor prerequisites, including generated production classes and processed resources. Bind the resulting original client archive and resolved runtime order by digest; clean the Maven working tree after each side. Cases: compsuite-i-39, compsuite-i-70, cucumber-reporting-1220.
expected: Record both original revisions, the precise unverified stage when unavailable and the true result on each qualified finite caller.
